raw_html: [[Shocking Blow#| Shocking Blow]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Shocking Blow#| Shocking Blow]]:''' This item is charged with electricity. When in melee, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will punish the target with a large electric shock (10 to 60 electric damage). A successful [[Reflex save]] (DC 22) reduces this damage by half.
